name: secuura
description: Secuura - Document Authenticity Platform on Cardano Blockchain

scripts.dev: docker-compose up -d && concurrently "npm run dev:services" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm run dev -w services/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/originate" "npm run dev -w services/auth" "npm run dev -w services/wallet-connector"
scripts.prod:backup: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.production.yml exec db-backup /backup.sh
scripts.prod:restore: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.production.yml exec db-backup /restore.sh
scripts.check:openapi: npm run generate-openapi -- --check && npm run check:spec-examples
scripts.check:test-types: node scripts/typecheck-tests/check.cjs services/auth && node scripts/typecheck-tests/check.cjs services/api-gateway && node scripts/typecheck-tests/check.cjs services/vc-issuer && node scripts/typecheck-tests/check.cjs services/security && node scripts/typecheck-tests/check.cjs services/m365-integration
scripts.e2e:install: npm --prefix tests/e2e ci && npm --prefix tests/e2e run playwright:install

// overrides: Audit 2.4 phase 2: pin known-vulnerable transitive deps to safe versions. path-to-regexp ReDoS GHSA-9wv6-86v2-598j — express 4.x uses 0.1.x so we pin to the patched ^0.1.13. node-forge basicConstraints bypass GHSA-2qmh-3rxg-87j8 — pin to 1.3.1+ (current 1.4.0). vite path-traversal in dev-server is dev-only (vite never runs in prod after build) and forcing v7 would break frontends still on v5 — left unpinned, documented as dev-only risk. undici GHSA (decompression/request-smuggling, fixed in 6.24+) reaches the prod tree only via the issuer-frontend's Cardano-SDK chain (@meshsdk/core → @utxorpc/sdk → @connectrpc/connect-node@1.4.0, which pins undici ^5.28.3). undici is a Node HTTP library: it is tree-shaken out of the Vite browser bundle and used by NO backend service, so it is never shipped to or executed in any deployed runtime — accepted-risk (KS-185). A scoped override dedupes to the hoisted undici@5 (no effect); a global pin to 6.x collaterally downgrades dev-only jsdom (7→6) and bumps testcontainers (5→6), risking the dev test tooling. Real fix lands when @utxorpc/sdk / @meshsdk adopt @connectrpc/connect-node@2.x (which drops the undici dependency) — tracked in KS-185.
// overrides KS-493: postcss ^8.5.24 (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q / GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849, path-traversal) — the residual 8.4.31 was nested under next's build tooling and its declared range pinned it below the fix; postcss 8.x is API-stable so a global pin is safe and build-time-only. valibot (GHSA-5qjj) is NOT overridden — @prisma/dev bundles valibot 1.2.0 (override is inert) and it is reached only via that dev-server tooling, so it is accepted as a dev-only baseline entry instead.
// overrides KS-530: @hono/node-server ^2.1.3 for @prisma/dev (GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f, serveStatic decodes the request path twice; vulnerable >=1.19.10 <2.1.3, so no 1.x release is fixed). Before: ^1.19.15, which held the one hoisted copy on 1.19.17. @prisma/dev 0.24.3 declares the exact 1.19.11 and the MCP SDK allows ^1.19.9 || ^2.0.5, so one override moves the single hoisted copy to v2. v2 needs node >=20 and a resolvable hono ^4 || ^5 (4.13.13 is locked). The main-entry API v1 exports is still exported; the only removed subpath is ./vercel, which nothing here imports. @prisma/dev calls serve({createServer, fetch, overrideGlobalObjects:false, port}) only inside `prisma dev`, which no script here runs.
